items.title: Point Extraction
items.text:
Extract metocean values at a point from large NetCDF files — without loading multi-GB grids into memory.

Work in progress

This tutorial is being actively expanded. The notebook runs end-to-end — updates will add more depth.

items.title: The problem
items.text: Reanalysis files (ERA5 and similar) are often too large to open naively on a laptop. This tutorial walks through point extraction workflows: slice what you need, export lightweight results, and keep analysis reproducible with open data.

items.title: Prerequisites
items.text: None — this is the first published Nusawave Labs tutorial.

items.title: Run the tutorial
items.text: Resource Link GitHub repo nusawave-labs/extract-point Notebook notebooks/extract_point.ipynb Utilities src/extract_utils.py Benchmarks benchmarks/

items.title: Repo structure
items.text:
extract-point/
├── notebooks/extract_point.ipynb   ← main Colab notebook
├── src/extract_utils.py            ← reusable functions
├── data/                           ← sample data (see repo README)
└── benchmarks/                     ← comparison scripts and figures

Sample data and pinned dependencies live in the tutorial repo, not this website. See the extract-point README for setup.
